summary: A reviewer asks why land that must stay open for drainage also has to admit the public.
realLife: In Dolan the Supreme Court found the city had failed to explain why a public greenway served flood control better than keeping the floodplain privately owned and undeveloped.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with parcel, condition, drainage need. A board member can ask staff to account for the public access part of a proposed condition.

turns.what: The applicant offers to keep the strip clear while retaining private ownership.
turns.pulledBy: The drainage engineer confirms that public entry is unnecessary for that purpose.
turns.writesBack: The board takes up a revised drainage condition.

turns.what: The engineer asks for occasional access to clear a blocked culvert while neighbors still want a daily walking route.
turns.pulledBy: The maintenance plan identifies a culvert reachable only across the parcel.
turns.writesBack: The board records maintenance access and public passage as two separate requests.
